title: Reusable Abaqus Phase-Field Adaptive-Remeshing Framework: Modularization, Input Validation, Deck Reconstruction, Indicator Sizing, Postprocessing, and Five-Hole Validation
objectives: Objective A: Develop a configurable, modular, reusable Python-Abaqus framework (scripts/method_a_framework/) supporting 2D continuum meshes, automatic MISESERI indicator calculation, 3-layer UEL production deck reconstruction, postprocessing, and visualization.
Objective A.1: Validate parameter schemas, physical bounds (E > 0, nu in (-1, 0.5), Gc > 0, l0 > 0, h_min < h_max, h_min <= l0/2), and JSON configuration persistence.
Objective A.2: Implement 2D continuum parser (CPE4/CPE3), aspect ratio and det(J) > 0 Jacobian auditing, boundary set detection, and diagnostic rejection of 3D/1D elements.
Objective A.3: Implement Superconvergent Patch Recovery (SPR) stress jump error indicator extraction, eta_e calculation, and continuous sizing field model clamped to [h_min, h_max].
Objective A.4: Implement 3-layer UEL + UMAT production input deck reconstruction with wrapped *NSET lines (<= 16 entries/line) and master reference node equations.

Objective A.5: Implement postprocessing with bottom-boundary reaction force equilibrium (F_tensile = -sum_{N_BOTTOM} RF_{2,j}), external work integration, volume-integrated element energy assembly (SDV17/SDV18), and damage bounds auditing.

Objective A.6: Implement 300-DPI publication figure generation, publish user guide (docs/user_guides/METHOD_A_FRAMEWORK_USER_GUIDE.md), benchmark configurations (configs/method_a/), and comprehensive unit tests (tests/unit/test_method_a_framework.py).

Objective B: Complete scientific validation of running five-hole adaptive phase-field simulation (PBS Job 1422257.mmaster02), extract staged telemetry upon ODB unlock, and compare against published Pandey & Kumar (2025) Section 4.5 Figures 22-25.
